title: Fix Design App Connection Visibility Again
description: Connections are not visible in the sketchpad design app. Need to investigate and fix the connection/edge rendering in the diagram.
summary: Fixed connection visibility by restoring edges={edges} to Diagram component and removing broken CustomDesignEdgeLayer ViewportPortal. 0 TS errors, 15/15 unit tests pass.
